transcript.answer: No, not any more. PR #2463 (merged 2026-10-02) added `.github/workflows/context-evals.yml`, which ran the context evals every night at 03:17 UTC and could also be started by hand. PR #2823 (reviewed 2026-10-19) then removed that workflow. After that PR, the spec's nightly-job section became "Running the evals": `scripts/context-evals/run.mjs` is run from a developer machine against the deployed lore-api, and nothing runs it on a schedule. I did not see PR #2823's merge state in what I read, only its description, the matching commit message and an approved review. So the removal is well documented, but I can't confirm it landed on main.

judgements.reason: The answer says no, and that the evals ran nightly from 2026-10-02 via #2463 until the workflow was removed, which matches the gold answer; its caveat about the removal PR's merge state does not reverse the 'No'.
